assertions.text: Uses one-line finding format with approved prefix token and includes location + problem + 'Fix:' on each finding.
Flags the highest-risk correctness issue before lower-priority comments.
Provides an actionable smallest-safe fix direction tied to the shown diff.
Requests the concrete review target when artifact is missing.
Avoids fabricated findings with fake file paths or line numbers.
Keeps the clarification concise and directly actionable.
Reports security findings before performance or style findings when multiple risks exist.
Each finding is a single prefixed line containing location, problem, and 'Fix:'.
Fix directions are concrete and minimal (e.g., parameterized query, remove/redact token logging, restore sane timeout bound).
